description: Kalmunai Municipal Council - Kalmunai Municipal Council, Butchers Ordinance - 2023
categorisation: This gazette content involves the issuance of trade licenses (butchers licenses and chicken stall licenses) to specific individuals and businesses within the Kalmunai Municipal Council area. It deals with commercial permits and business operations, specifically for meat-related trade activities, which falls under the Commercial Gazettes category (Type 6) for business and commercial matters including trade licenses and commercial permits.
